answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 46840 Country: India Title: about quran reading Question: Please, give answer in the light of Hadith and Quran. Which is good way to read Quran "MARUF" or "MAJHUL"? Or if anyone can read Quran in "MAJHUL" way, it is unlawful or not? Answer ID: 46840 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1220/1118/N=9/1434) According to the recitation method of Imam Hafs, all the letters of the Quran with zamma and kasra should be recited in maruf way, not majhul way; except the letter of ra in (مجريها). Reciting it in majhul way is not haram but it causes the loss of beauty in recitation of the Quran. Yes, if it was recited majhul in a way that caused changing in meaning then it will be unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
